import subprocess, re, collections, sys
commit='e3c1782b96'
base=commit+'~10'
repo='.'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=repo, check=True, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
paths=git('diff','--name-only',base,commit).splitlines()
paths=[p for p in paths if p.endswith(('.ts','.tsx','.mts','.cts'))]
markers=[]
for path in paths:
    blob=subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{commit}:{path}'],cwd=repo,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if blob.returncode: continue
    for line_no,line in enumerate(blob.stdout.splitlines(),1):
        if '@plan' not in line: continue
        ids=re.findall(r'@plan\s+([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*)',line)
        if not ids:
            markers.append((path,line_no,'<unparsed>',line.strip(),'<unknown>'))
            continue
        blame=subprocess.run(['git','blame','-L',f'{line_no},{line_no}','--line-porcelain',commit,'--',path],cwd=repo,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        blamed=blame.stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[0] if blame.returncode==0 and blame.stdout else '<blame-error>'
        for plan_id in ids:
            markers.append((path,line_no,plan_id,line.strip(),blamed))
plans=collections.Counter(m[2] for m in markers)
pkgs=collections.Counter((m[0].split('/')[1] if m[0].startswith('packages/') and len(m[0].split('/'))>2 else '<outside packages/>') for m in markers)
blames=collections.Counter(m[4][:7] for m in markers)
print('Changed TypeScript paths:',len(paths))
print('Marker lines/instances:',len(markers))
print('\nPer plan ID:')
for k,v in sorted(plans.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('\nPer package:')
for k,v in sorted(pkgs.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('\nPer blamed short commit:')
for k,v in sorted(blames.items()): print(f'{k}\t{v}')
print('\nTotal:',len(markers))
print('\nMarkers:')
for p,n,i,line,h in markers: print(f'{p}:{n}\t{i}\t{h}\t{line}')
